sum_of_balances.meaning: sum of all address balances of the HypoVault token

bootstrap_shares_unallocated.meaning: deployment initialized totalSupply with 1,000,000 shares not allocated to any address

phantom_shares_present.meaning: shares exist in totalSupply that are owned by no address

claims.scope: HypoVault share accounting: bootstrap totalSupply initialization and fulfillDeposits/executeDeposit share allocation

preconditions.text: At deployment the HypoVault contract initializes totalSupply with 1,000,000 shares without allocating them to any address.; Shares exist in totalSupply that are not owned by anyone (phantom shares).
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: totalSupply should equal the sum of all balances, with no shares counted that are not owned by an address.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: totalSupply does not equal the sum of all balances, violating the ERC20 invariant.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The bootstrap 1,000,000 shares are minted once at deployment and not re-created.
No attacker transaction is required; the imbalance arises from deployment initialization and the fulfillDeposits/executeDeposit mechanism.

limitations: Only the totalSupply-equals-sum-of-balances invariant is formalized; the 66% value-loss and underpricing impacts are handled in separate passes.

The conservation pattern compares before/after equality of total_supply and sum_of_balances; the report's phantom-share mechanism is captured via the trigger and precondition facts rather than a per-address allocation model.
